title: Calc Coach
subtitle: AP Calculus BC, one mastered skill at a time

units.title: Limits and Continuity
units.blurb: What it means for a function to approach a value, how to compute limits, and what continuity guarantees.

units.title: Differentiation: Definition and Fundamental Properties
units.blurb: The derivative as a limit, derivative rules for sums, products, quotients, and the basic function library.

units.title: Differentiation: Composite, Implicit, and Inverse Functions
units.blurb: The chain rule, implicit differentiation, and derivatives of inverse functions including inverse trig.

units.title: Contextual Applications of Differentiation
units.blurb: Rates of change in context, related rates, linear approximation, and L'Hôpital's rule.

units.title: Analytical Applications of Differentiation
units.blurb: Mean Value Theorem, extrema, concavity, curve sketching, and optimization.

units.title: Integration and Accumulation of Change
units.blurb: Riemann sums, the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus, antiderivatives, u-substitution, integration by parts, and partial fractions.

units.title: Differential Equations
units.blurb: Slope fields, Euler's method, separation of variables, exponential growth, and the logistic model.

units.title: Applications of Integration
units.blurb: Average value, motion, area between curves, volumes by slicing and revolution, and arc length.

units.title: Parametric Equations, Polar Coordinates, and Vector-Valued Functions
units.blurb: Calculus on parametric curves, vector-valued motion, and polar coordinates including polar area.

units.title: Infinite Sequences and Series
units.blurb: Convergence tests, error bounds, power series, and Taylor and Maclaurin series.
